data.title: Bank asks for ID copy and self-disclosure form (money laundering law)
data.summary: Muster Bank AG asks David Muster to send a copy of a valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen) under the Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). The documents are due within 8 working days of the letter date of 18 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your bank must regularly update your customer data by law. It needs a copy of your valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen). The period is 8 working days (Werktage, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) counted from the letter date; the app shows the deadline. If you don't send the documents in time, the bank says it will block your securities account (Depot) for purchases until the matter is resolved. If you are unsure the letter is genuine, contact the bank using the phone number or address from your own bank records, not from this letter.
